biography: Max Thompson, a name whispered with anticipation in the Belgian karting scene, hails from the small town of Spa, a stone's throw from the legendary circuit. Racing is practically in his blood, his grandfather a mechanic for local rally teams, his father a weekend warrior in historic touring cars. Max's journey began at age six with a hand-me-down kart, tearing around a makeshift track in a farmer's field. A defining moment came at the Belgian National Karting Championship in 2021, where, despite mechanical issues plaguing him throughout the weekend, he clawed his way from last to second in the final race, showcasing a raw talent that turned heads. Now at 18, Max navigates the cutthroat world of open-wheel racing, bouncing between independent teams, a situation that tests his mettle and exposes his inconsistent nature. He displays flashes of brilliance, but struggles with consistency, a hurdle he desperately seeks to overcome to prove he belongs at the pinnacle of motorsport.
drivingStyle: Thompson's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's known for his aggressive overtakes, often diving late into corners and relying on car control to wrestle the machine back into line. Tire management is a work in progress; he tends to overdrive the car early in a stint, sacrificing longevity for immediate pace. While he thrives under pressure when chasing the leaders, maintaining a consistent pace when in front proves to be a challenge, often cracking under pressure and making crucial errors.
rivalries: Antoine Dubois - A karting rival since childhood, Antoine's consistent, calculated approach clashes with Max's aggressive style, creating intense on-track battles.
Isabella Rossi - Another open-wheel hopeful, Isabella and Max have a history of close calls and near misses, fueled by their shared ambition and competitive nature.
Liam O'Connell - A driver from another independent team, Liam and Max constantly fight for the same position, leading to tense races and post-race discussions.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky socks, regardless of how many times they've been washed (or not).
Before each race, he meticulously polishes his helmet visor until it's spotless.
He listens to a specific 80s rock anthem on repeat during the pre-race warm-up.
famousQuote: Sometimes you gotta risk it for the biscuit. Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 Formula Regional European Championship race at Imola. Starting from P8, he executed a series of daring overtakes in the rain, securing his first major victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2023 Formula 3 race at Monza. He lost control while trying to defend from a late attack, handing the victory to his rival, Antoine Dubois.
